summary.en-US: The four Gospels side by side, one screen at a time

description.en-US:
A synopsis of the four Gospels for reading and study. Rather than
blending the accounts into one harmony, it keeps each Evangelist in
his own column, in his own order, over the standard pericope
sequence.

On a phone the columns become a swipeable strip: one Gospel fills the
screen, the tabs above jump between Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, and
the outline lives in a drawer behind the menu button. Tapping a verse
pins it and opens its closest wording in the other Gospels; tapping a
parallel jumps to that Gospel at the matching verse.

Passage text is the NET Bible, fetched from the NET Bible API and
cached on the device for offline reading. Scripture quotations are
copyright Biblical Studies Press, L.L.C., and are used by permission.
